#### github profile: add egress network policy configuration

Add --egress_policy and --egress_domain_allow_list flags to the
create and update commands. Display network policy in describe
output and JSON output.

Accepts both short-form (NONE, DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST) and full proto
enum names. Validates that domain allow list is only used with
DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST policy. Update command handles partial updates,
preserving existing allow list when only policy is changed.

Also updates buf.build proto dependencies to pick up the new
NetworkPolicy field on RunnerProfileSpec.
